skill.name: pptx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and validate PowerPoint presentations using OOXML tools, template inventories, and HTML-to-slide conversion.
skill.summary: Build and maintain PowerPoint presentations with structured editing and validation workflows.
skill.author: Azeem-2

security_audit.summary: Most static results are scanner false positives from OOXML schemas, documentation, JavaScript template literals, and routine presentation tooling. Four unvalidated archive extraction calls create Zip Slip risks, and HTML conversion can expose readable local image resources from untrusted HTML. Static review was capped at 400 of 506 representative matches, so the omitted matches require manual review before automatic publication.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 106 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Archive extraction accepts unvalidated ZIP member paths.
remediation.suggestion: Replace extractall with a safe extractor that rejects absolute paths and members resolving outside the destination directory.

remediation.issue: HTML conversion can resolve arbitrary local file URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only approved asset directories, reject file URLs outside them, and disable or intercept browser requests when converting untrusted HTML.

remediation.issue: Office files are passed to external rendering tools.
remediation.suggestion: Run document conversion in a sandboxed, least-privilege environment and keep LibreOffice and Poppler updated.

content.value_statement: Creating or modifying PowerPoint files can require careful work with layouts, slide content, and package structure. This skill provides workflows for creating, inspecting, editing, validating, and rendering PPTX presentations.
actual_capabilities: Create presentations from structured HTML and convert them to PPTX slides.
Inspect PPTX templates and extract slide, layout, font, and theme information.
Extract and replace presentation text while preserving supported formatting properties.
Reorder, duplicate, and remove slides in an existing presentation.
Edit OOXML package files and validate Office document structure.
Render presentation thumbnails for visual review.
limitations: Requires compatible local tools for rendering or PDF conversion, such as LibreOffice and Poppler.
HTML conversion supports the documented subset of HTML and CSS only.
Complex animations, embedded media, and unsupported PowerPoint features may not be preserved.
Processes local presentation files and does not provide collaborative editing or cloud storage.

use_cases.title: Build a client presentation
use_cases.description: Create a branded slide deck from an outline and review it through generated thumbnails.

use_cases.title: Update a company template
use_cases.description: Inspect a template, replace approved text, and preserve layout and styling details.

use_cases.title: Repair presentation structure
use_cases.description: Unpack, edit, validate, and repack OOXML files when normal presentation editing is insufficient.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint presentation about [topic]. Use a title slide, three content slides, and a final summary slide. Keep each slide concise.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a template
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [template.pptx] and summarize its layouts, theme colors, fonts, slide count, and reusable design patterns before creating new content.

prompt_templates.title: Replace approved copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from [deck.pptx], replace only the approved phrases in [replacement list], and preserve the existing slide order and formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Create and validate a deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PPTX from [outline] using [template.pptx]. Validate the output, generate thumbnails, and report any layout or rendering issues.

output_examples.input: Inspect the supplied sales template before creating a deck.
output: Template summary with slide count and layouts
Recommended slide patterns for the new deck

output_examples.input: Create a short project update presentation.
output: A PPTX file with title, progress, risks, and next-step slides
A thumbnail grid for visual review
A validation summary for the generated file

output_examples.input: Replace approved product names in an existing presentation.
output: An updated presentation with requested replacements
A note about any text that could not be matched safely

best_practices: Inspect the template before adding content so the deck uses existing layouts and styles.
Keep slide text brief and review thumbnails for clipping, overlap, and weak visual hierarchy.
Validate the PPTX after OOXML edits and keep the original file unchanged until review is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not edit OOXML files without unpacking and validating the package.
Do not place large paragraphs on slides that require concise visual communication.
Do not assume unsupported HTML, CSS, animations, or media will render correctly.

faq.question: What presentation files can this skill work with?
faq.answer: It focuses on PowerPoint PPTX files and their OOXML package contents.

faq.question: Can it create a presentation from an outline?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide creation of a slide structure and generate a PPTX workflow from that content.

faq.question: Can it reuse an existing template?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect a template and use its layouts, colors, fonts, and slide patterns.

faq.question: Can it edit text in an existing deck?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes inventory and replacement workflows for supported text and formatting properties.

faq.question: How can I check the visual result?
faq.answer: Generate thumbnails and inspect them for clipping, overlaps, and inconsistent spacing.

faq.question: Does it require additional software?
faq.answer: Some rendering and conversion workflows require locally installed tools such as LibreOffice and Poppler.
